querySql:
select 
                                      id,
                                      stock_code,
                                      stock_name,
                                      con_date,
                                      con_year,
                                      con_or,
                                      con_or_type,
                                      con_or_hisdate,
                                      con_np,
                                      con_np_type,
                                      con_np_hisdate,
                                      con_eps,
                                      con_eps_type,
                                      con_eps_hisdate,
                                      con_na,
                                      con_pb,
                                      con_ps,
                                      con_pe,
                                      con_peg,
                                      con_roe,
                                      con_or_yoy,
                                      con_np_yoy,
                                      con_npcgrate_2y,
                                      con_npgrate_1w,
                                      con_npgrate_4w,
                                      con_npgrate_13w,
                                      con_npgrate_26w,
                                      con_npgrate_52w,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'zyyx_con_forecast_stk.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.con_forecast_stk WHERE con_date BETWEEN '${beg_date}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${beg_date}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
